rules.name: FiveM / RedM cache & logs
rules.why: FiveM/RedM download caches, server caches and logs only. Your game-storage, mods, plugins and citizen folders are never touched.
sources: CitizenFX (FiveM) stores re-downloadable caches under FiveM.app\data\cache, server-cache and server-cache-priv, plus logs and crashes; these are rebuilt on next launch.

rules.name: Adobe media cache
rules.why: Adobe's conformed media cache (Premiere Pro, After Effects). Rebuilt automatically; projects re-open fine but may take longer the first time. Moved to Quarantine so it can be restored.
sources: Adobe stores conformed/peak media cache under %APPDATA%\Adobe\Common\Media Cache Files and Media Cache; Adobe documents clearing it to reclaim space. https://helpx.adobe.com/premiere-pro/kb/clean-media-cache.html
